about_the_game:
Add-on for Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii including the Majima Construction Anthem as a playable karaoke song, and a variety of CDs to add to your in-game playlist.

■ EXTRA KARAOKE SONG
- Majima Construction Anthem

■ CD COLLECTION SET
- Majima Construction Anthem
- Kamurocho Lullaby (Kiryu)
- Machine Gun Kiss (Kiryu)
- Baka Mitai (Kiryu)
- Judgement -Shinpan- (Kiryu)
- Iji Sakura / Fighting Sakura (Kiryu)
- Iji Sakura 2000 / Fighting Sakura 2000 (Kiryu)
- Tonight -restart from this night- (Kiryu)
- Today is a Diamond (Kiryu)
- Hands (Kiryu)
- Ichizu Samurai / Truehearted Samurai (Kiryu)
- Sayonara, Silent Night (Kiryu)
- Shin Ichizu Samurai (Kiryu)
- Baka Darou (Kiryu)
- The Future I Dreamed Of (Ichiban)
- Hell Stew (Ichiban)
- Judgement -Shinpan- (Ichiban)
- Summertime Groove (Ichiban)
- GET to the Top! (Majima)
- 24-Hour Cinderella (Majima)
- As Long as You're Happy (Majima)
- Pride from Despair (Majima & Kiryu)
- Samurai Ondo / Dirge of the Warrior (Majima)
- Majima no MajiROCK (Majima)
- Majima Construction Anthem (Majima)
- Majima Construction Anthem (All Majima Construction Employees)
- Machine Gun Kiss (Adachi)
- Spring Breeze (Saeko)
- AWAKE (Saeko)
- Hell Stew (Zhao)
- If I Could Love the One I Love (Zhao)
- If I Could Love the One I Love (Joongi Han)
- Honolulu City Lights (Chitose)
- Like A Butterfly (Seonhee)
- Baka Mitai (Saejima)
- Kokyou ni Nishiki wo Kazaru Beshi / In Glory I'll Return (Saejima)
- x3 SHINE (Yuki)
- Ring (Yuki)
- Raindrops (Hana)
- Asura Komachi / Asura's Beloved (Hana)

*Please be aware that the additional content included in this edition is also sold in separate sets or editions.
*You must own a copy of Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii in order to use this add-on content. Please update the game by downloading the latest patch and updating before using it.
*The “Extra Karaoke & BGM Pack” will be available after gaining access to a smartphone in Chapter 1 of the main game.
*The contents of the ""Extra Karaoke & CD Pack"" will not be counted toward in-game achievements.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10 1909 (Build18363.1350)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470,3.2GHz or AMD Ryzen 3 1200, 3.1GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650,4GB or AMD Radeon RX 560,4GB or Intel Arc A380,6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: 1080p Low@30FPS w/Balanced FSR1.0,requires a CPU with supports the AVX and SSE4.2 instruction set
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10 1909 (Build18363.1350)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790,3.6GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1600, 3.2GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060,6GB or AMD Radeon RX 5700,8GB or Intel Arc A750,8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: 1080p High@60FPS w/o FSR , requires a CPU with supports the AVX and SSE4.2 instruction set, SSD recommended
